From: Sarah Jenkins <sarah.jenkins@holohealth.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@holohealth.com
Date: Fri, 5 Jun 2027 08:22:14 -0700
Subject: Private hosting and audit access — initial ask

Hi Soojin,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. HoloHealth is excited about Redwood's private deployment option — the ability to run in our AWS account with customer-managed keys is a hard requirement for our pilot. A couple of details we need to clarify so we can move our procurement review forward: 

- Data residency: Must be US-only; logs stored in our account in us-east-1.
- Audit access: We need the ability to run an external compliance audit once per year. For access, we expect a timeboxed read-only ops session (up to 72 hours) with an approved third-party auditor.
- Admin access: We can accept read-only 'ops' role but request temporary jumpbox access for the auditor during the window.
- KMS/HSM: We require a customer-managed KMS key and attestations that Redwood will not hold a copy of unwrapped keys.
- Pricing: Given additional operational burden, we would need a 20% one-year commit discount and a small pilot rate for the first 3 months.

Can you confirm whether Redwood can accommodate these controls and what the commercial terms would look like? We need a tentative SOW and a cost estimate by next Wednesday (2027-06-09) to keep our internal IRB and procurement timeline on track.

Appreciate the help — happy to jump on a quick call if helpful.

Best,
Sarah Jenkins
Director, IT Security
HoloHealth Inc.

Attachment: security-qa.xlsx (see page 2 for KMS questions)

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Jenkins <sarah.jenkins@holohealth.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 5 Jun 2027 10:07:40 -07:00
Subject: Re: Private hosting and audit access — initial ask

Hi Sarah — thanks for the clear list. Short answers up front: we can deliver a US-only private deployment in your AWS account, support customer-managed KMS, and we can accommodate a timeboxed audit session with a read-only ops role subject to a scoped access playbook.

Notes / clarifications:
- Audit window: we typically allow timeboxed access and prefer 48 hours/year as our standard concession. 72 hours is possible but requires exec approval because it increases our exposure surface and operational cost.
- Jumpbox: we can provide a temporary bastion with session recording disabled only if a signed access playbook and NDA amendment are in place.
- KMS/HSM: we support CMK (customer-managed key) in your account; Redwood will not retain plaintext keys. We do not offer HSM custody by Redwood — if HSM escrow is required, legal will need to review language carefully.
- Pricing: a 20% single-year upfront discount for a standard private deployment is above our baseline for this segment; we can propose a pilot concession (reduced rate for first 90 days) tied to a 12-month committed term.

I'm looping in Marissa (lead AE) and Ben (commercial ops) to scope the commercial ask and get an exec decision on the 72-hour audit window and the 20% discount. I'll draft a short SOW and share it by EOD.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

Attachment: HoloHealth_SOW_draft_v3.pdf (draft SOW, pilot + production options)

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 5 Jun 2027 10:12:03 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: HoloHealth: private deployment + audit access / discount request — exec approval needed

Team — forwarding Sarah's note and our initial reply. Quick ask: we need an executive sign-off on two non-standard concessions to close this ARR opportunity (deal DL-7832):

1) Audit window: customer requests 72 hours/year for an external auditor with temporary bastion access. Risk: increases operational burden and compliance exposure. Ask: approve up to 72 hours/year OR counter with 48 hours/year.
2) Commercial: customer requested 20% one-year discount + pilot reduced rate for first 90 days. Ask: approve up to 20% if tied to a 12-month committed term and signed PO. Prefer 15% as an alternate.

Other requirements we can deliver without exec approval: US-only residency, CMK in their account, limited read-only ops role. Legal needs to review HSM/escrow and NDA amendment for auditor access.

Why approve: this is a strategically important health-tech pilot (HoloHealth), easy expansion path if pilot succeeds, and opens reference for our medtech vertical. ARR upside is ~ $1.1M ARR if they convert after pilot.

Risks and mitigations:
- Access: require signed access playbook, scoped jumpbox, strict IAM policies, and timeboxed API keys.
- Audit scope: limit to logs and configurations; deny access to production PII fields.
- Insurance: require auditor to carry cyber coverage; include indemnity carveouts in SOW.

Attachments: HoloHealth_SOW_draft_v3.pdf, security-qa.xlsx

Soojin

Thanks for the thorough ask and the risk mitigations, Soojin. I reviewed the background with Product and Risk. Approvals and conditions below: 

1) Audit window: approve a maximum of 48 hours per year for an external auditor. If HoloHealth insists on 72 hours, escalate to CRO with a clear risk memo. 48 hours must be scoped to logs, configurations, and non-PII system metadata. No interactive write-level access to any PII stores.

2) Commercial concession: approve up to 15% discount on list for a 12-month committed term. If the customer signs a 12-month PO and pays 50% upfront, we can increase to 18% but not to 20%. Pilot concession: approve reduced pilot rate (50% of list) for first 60 days only; beyond that, standard committed pricing applies.

3) KMS/HSM: we can support CMK in the customer's account. We will not provide HSM key escrow. If the customer requires HSM escrow, Legal must negotiate narrow language and we may require a platform fee.

4) Controls: require an approved access playbook, customer-signed auditor NDA amendment, and an operations runbook that Redwood must pre-approve. All access will be supervised by Redwood on-call and logged. Any non-standard telemetry or elevated access must be pre-authorized in writing.

Next steps: Soojin/Marissa — put Laura's approved concessions into a redline and SOW revision. Legal and Risk to review access playbook and the indemnity language. Ben — update deal record (DL-7832) and prepare two pricing options (15% / 18% with 50% upfront).

Laura Bennett
VP, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

- Commercial: 15% discount off list with a 12-month committed term. Option for 18% if HoloHealth provides 50% upfront payment at signing. Pilot concession: 60-day reduced pilot rate (50% of list).
- Residency/KMS: US-only deployment in your AWS account (us-east-1) with customer-managed CMK. Redwood will not retain unwrapped keys.
- Audit access: Approved up to 48 hours per year for an external auditor. Access is strictly read-only and scoped to logs/configuration. Temporary bastion access will be provided only after execution of an auditor NDA amendment and an approved access playbook.
- HSM/escrow: Not supported by Redwood. If required, Legal will need to negotiate and a platform fee may apply.
- Controls: All auditor activity will be logged; Redwood will provide a post-audit access report and remediation ticket list if issues are found.
